scope: Three V13 waiting roots, unchanged fitted ordered-chain model, graph, deadline, 120-second MCT and public platform events. Evaluation uses independent posterior simulations, not independent real dates.
control: Original V13 first_visible, same original primary incumbent until measured publication. Every action must come from the public platform model.
candidate: Use the existing timetable first-candidate screen (legal, scheduled within 720 seconds of readiness), freeze one complete path per candidate. At each actually visible departure, integrate arrival and service conditional on its exact operating departure on the frozen grid, through the full fixed itinerary. Other trips keep their root model. Accept an extra candidate only when its expected capped absolute arrival improves on the waiting proxy by a frozen margin. Waiting uses the original A/B candidate clocks, own departure/absence evidence and current V13 cursor; it treats the rescue as eligible as soon as physically boardable. These are policy scores, not population value bounds.

random_streams.selection: Among 0, 60 and 120-second margins choose lowest aggregate pilot loss, ties choose larger margin. No held-out world used in selection.

cost: Count candidate screen, all conditional table preparation, rule binding and runtime actions. Publication uses measured costs; the common initial plan runs until publication. Record actual loss even if preparation passes readiness. Record CPU and wall time. Fit, world drawing, evaluation and hindsight scan are separate.
inference: Retain all held-out worlds and failure caps. J_F minus candidate loss is paired. Its lower confidence bound lower bounds true strategy regret. J_F minus full-world hindsight upper bounds J_F minus the original bank expectation. Use physical cap and no-walk readiness floor. Joint coverage with previous constraints allocates a combined family alpha of .05. Do not use validation to replace the chosen margin.
precision_confirmation: After the original 128-world holdout, the two longer roots both show point gain >60 seconds. Freeze a single additional 512-world batch at each of those two roots with unchanged selected margin and code, SeedSequence([20261116,int(date),query,decision,2]). The new batch is independent of the 128-world sample and is reported separately. For population constraints the existing anytime linear e-test may use the concatenated tape, with root selection or stopping based on the earlier tape. Preserve the original alpha allocation. No further precision round.
point_diagnostic: On the original 128-world holdout tape, keep the same available route IDs, exact departure evidence, A/B departure masses and margin. Replace each itinerary's loss integration by plug-in operating clock means (conditional on first-trip departure, root means for other trips) and deterministic transfer checks. This follow-up compares decision behavior and does not select a new policy or enter population confidence constraints.
g2: 60-second model authorization threshold unchanged. Separately assess loss, actual compute cost, bound validity and method increment.
